description: The chefs are split again, and the belts no longer loop: each run carries toward one of three bins, so anything nobody catches is thrown away. Binned plates and pans come back. Pans, crates and sink on one side; boards and plates on the other.
strategy: Say what you are sending before it goes on the belt, and be at the far end to catch it. The third pan lets the cooking side fry a batch of patties at once, which suits sending several pieces of beef together.
